note: What a native frame may differ from the web picture of the same frame and still pass (#569). Channel units, 0..255.
grid: the picture is judged in columns x rows regions; a region's delta is the largest difference between the two pictures' mean channel values there.
blank: a native frame with less spread or fewer colours than this, or more of it the clear colour, drew nothing.
noise: two read-backs of one frame on one device. A renderer replaying a frozen frame should draw it identically.
web: the native frame resampled to the web canvas. Provisional until a measured run sets them: see docs/mobile-hosted-verification.md.
